# improve git flow

Let the flow accept URLs where it now expects identifiers:

```bash
$ git flow jira https://abc.atlassian.net
$ git start https://qaseio.atlassian.net/browse/XYZ-1234
# git start XYZ-1234
```

`git flow jira <url>` already takes the tracker URL; `git start` should additionally accept a pasted issue URL and extract the key (`XYZ-1234`) from it — the browser tab is where the issue is, and copying the URL is faster and less error-prone than retyping the key. The same applies to GitHub issue URLs for the `github` flavour.
